independent_sensor.sampling: same inclusive sparse circular query for every profile

interpretation: Only the common seed changes each original preset; module configuration and original shared_seed=false remain intact, with the same authored instance 100.
Each arm owns a fresh native World, a fresh World2D/Rapier space and the same initial native publication bytes and complete copied actor part/pose/resource values.
Every arm completes 1800 native and Rapier steps, 30 simulated seconds and 300 issued decisions. Last pre-step decision time 29.9 s is distinct from terminal time 30 s.
The independent evaluator observes Oil and Water within 50 world cells for all profiles; it does not feed controls.
Path sums actual center movement each physical step, including vertical motion and gait. It is neither net displacement nor a measure of useful exploration.
Oil Moth has 64/299 stalled active intervals and 83 obstruction-escape decisions against the physically obstructed Oil cup; this limitation is retained.
Idle Mechanic completes two selected five-second rests and resumes genuine nonzero intent and command; a third rest is truncated by the observation window.
Idle Mechanic moves 37.2286 cells while its selected rest intentions and commands remain neutral. Physical inertia and articulated response are separate from decision resumption.
Nearest material distances are nearest observed native samples. Dynamic material can change distance independently of actor approach; this controlled cup run retained unchanged material revision 2.
All profiles receive 300 real own-energy observations with value 1.0. Resource coverage does not establish resource-sensitive decisions or depletion.

This is one matched 30-second Linux headless observation per profile with no confidence interval, cross-platform trajectory determinism, subjective believability ranking or Windows/NVIDIA playfeel claim.

metric_definitions.material_range: nearest observed native numeric-ID sample within50 cells; cups may be inaccessible
metric_definitions.oscillation: nonzero X sign changes with 0.05 deadzone; includes legitimate braking or reflexes
metric_definitions.physical_path_during_rest: actual body travel while selected rest remains neutral; drift is not active intention
metric_definitions.rest: selected scheduled-rest override; candidate activity reported separately
metric_definitions.resume: selected rest ended, then nonzero procedural intention and normalized command observed
metric_definitions.stall: preceding command move length >0.05 and displacement <0.25 cells over six physical ticks
metric_definitions.time: decisions precede their step; terminal physical time30s and last decision time29.9s are distinct

profile_seed_mode: original shared_seed=false; same authored instance and seed in every arm

reduction.method: Retain campaign metrics, profiles, initial/final states, source hashes and execution custody. Remove only per-decision trace arrays; derive labelled fractions, ranges and consecutive selected-override intervals from the original trace.
reduction.source_form: Committed product c63cea9ef10d21f264c9a235437f7fd40acb1072 plus explicitly recorded local new test file; product sources hash-matched at execution. Later final committed-source qualification is separate.

scope: Synchronous native/Rapier observation. No subjective personality, global route or Windows/NVIDIA playfeel acceptance.
